# Voyado

> > Voyado provides an Agentic AI-powered CX suite for retail, featuring customer loyalty platforms (Voyado Engage), personalization engines (Voyado Elevate), and retail media solutions.

Voyado specializes in omnichannel customer engagement, retention, and loyalty programs for retail businesses, with integrated digital wallet support (Apple Wallet, Google Wallet), marketing automation, and AI-driven personalization capabilities. The platform helps retailers build sustainable customer relationships through data-driven insights and seamless customer experiences.

## Key Topics

- Voyado Engage
- Voyado Elevate
- Customer loyalty programs
- Personalization
- Omnichannel retail
- Digital wallet (Apple Wallet, Google Wallet)
- Retail media
- Customer retention
- Marketing automation
- Email marketing
- Customer data platform
- Product discovery
- Conversion optimization
- A/B testing
- Customer experience (CX)

## Core Products & Features

- [The Agentic CX Suite for Retail](https://voyado.com): Homepage: Agentic AI-powered CX suite for retail loyalty and personalization
- [Wallet](https://voyado.com/wallet): Digital wallet integration with Apple/Google Wallet for loyalty programs
- [Help desk](https://voyado.com/products/customer-loyalty-platform/help-desk): Help desk feature integrating customer data with Voyado Engage
- [Dixa Integration](https://voyado.com/dixa): Dixa integration for personalized customer service with Voyado Engage
- [Advertiser campaign management](https://voyado.com/advertiser-campaign-management): Self-service retail media platform for brand campaign management
